links.outcome: Readability (Flesch Reading Ease Score) of LLM responses to post-THA patient questions
links.effect: Best readability was ChatGPT 3.5 with median FRES = 55; the other models scored lower. Significant differences in readability were found among models.
links.quote: Gemini scored significantly higher in reliability (P < 0.001), whereas ChatGPT 3.5 achieved the greatest readability (median FRES = 55).

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, reliability, quality, and readability of responses from multiple LLMs to simulated patient questions following total hip arthroplasty without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
